title: Drop-In Membership
how_to_join: Contact studio directly at (608) 419-2640 or manager@thekilnshed.studio
summary: Drop-in membership with four visits per month (or daily visits for $10) includes firing services; drop off work and pick up after firing in wood, gas reduction, or electric kilns.
evidence_sentence: The membership page notes drop-in members can drop off work to be fired in their kilns.
evidence_quote: WOOD FIRED REDUCTION CONE 10 SODA REDUCTION CONE 10
